newsitem.title: UK: Cox buys capacity in second Lloyd's auction.
newsitem.headline: Cox buys capacity in second Lloyd's auction.

text.p: Cox Insurance Holdings Plc Plc said on Friday it had acquired 19.6 million stg of capacity on its managed syndicates during the second of Lloyd's 1997 capacity auctions.
Total consideration payable, in cash, was approximately 3.4 million stg.
Syndicate 218 acquired seven million stg of capacity at 13 pence per pound of capacity, syndicate 1485 10.1 million stg at 15 pence per pound and syndicate 1176 at 40 pence per pound.
Cox said it would continue to participate in future auctions at these prices.
The company said it remained committed, subject to its success in acquiring capacity during the auction process, to making a general cash offer with a share alternative in the near future.
